errors.evidence: The "No Delay" line (blue with circles) starts at an accuracy of approximately 72, not 74. It is visibly lower than the starting point of the "Delay" line.
In the description of the "No Delay" line, the starting point is described as being at a cache ratio of 0.2. However, the first data point is located at approximately 0.24 on the x-axis.
In the description of the "No Delay" line, the ending point is described as being at a cache ratio of 0.5. However, the last data point is located at approximately 0.485 on the x-axis.
In the description of the "Delay" line, the starting point is described as being at a cache ratio of 0.2. However, the first data point is located at approximately 0.24 on the x-axis.
In the description of the "Delay" line, the ending point is described as being at a cache ratio of 0.5. However, the last data point is located at approximately 0.485 on the x-axis.
